Role Readiness Check

Is this still the right role?

AI and automation are changing parts of many jobs. Answer seven simple questions to see whether one of your roles should stay as it is, be updated or be thought through again.

3 minutes to complete
7 questions in plain English
1 clear brief to take away
“If this person left tomorrow, would you recruit the same role again?”

Your answers stay on this device. Nothing is sent to Next Generation unless you request a Role Decision Brief.

The role Step 1 of 4
01

Start with one real role

Which role are you reviewing?

Choose a role you already have or may need in the next 12–24 months.

Question 1 Why are you looking at this role?

Please add the role, choose the area of the business and tell us why you are reviewing it.

02

What is happening around the role?

What has changed?

Choose everything that has had a real effect on the role.

Question 2 What is changing around this role?
Question 3 Where does most of the person’s time go?

Choose up to three.

Choose no more than three.

Please choose at least one answer for each question.

03

Look at the work itself

How does the work get done?

These two questions help separate work technology can support from work that depends on people.

Question 4 How much of the work is repeated or follows clear rules?
Question 5 How much depends on judgment, trust or personal responsibility?

Please answer both questions before continuing.

04

Your instinct matters

What are you leaning towards?

Do not overthink it. Choose the answer that feels closest today.

Question 6 Would you look for the same type of person you hired last time?
Question 7 What do you currently think the business needs?

Please answer both questions to build your brief.

Complimentary Role Decision Brief

Turn this result into a decision you can use.

Bring us one important role. In a focused 15-minute review, we will challenge the assumptions behind it and send you a practical one-page brief within two working days.

The online result is the starting point. The brief adds human challenge and current talent-market evidence to your specific role.

  • What work to protect, improve, automate or stop
  • Which capabilities to develop—and which to recruit
  • A clear Keep, Update or Rethink recommendation
  • A talent-market reality check: availability, likely scarcity and adjacent profiles

No preparation or open vacancy is needed. There is no recruitment commitment.

We send the contact details, role and result shown here. Your question-by-question answers and task map stay on your device.

Why this check exists

AI changes parts of jobs—not every job in the same way

01

Start with the actual work

Look at the tasks people perform before deciding whether a role will disappear, remain or change.

02

Keep people responsible

Important decisions still need clear human judgment, challenge and accountability.

03

Do not recruit yesterday’s role

Update the work and skills first, then decide whether to recruit, develop someone or redesign the role.

Research behind the check

This tool is distilled from Next Generation’s 2026 research into how AI may change work and talent decisions. The underlying report reviewed 75 sources.

This is a practical management tool, not a scientific test, legal opinion or prediction that a job will disappear. Its purpose is to help managers ask better questions before making a decision.
